THE AUDUBON INN

History you can
stay in.

Built in 1896, the property was originally known as the Beaumont Hotel. Designed by Henry Messmer & Son for Jacob and Anna Mueller, it has been part of Mayville’s story for generations.

Today, the Audubon Inn brings guest rooms, gathering spaces, and the Beaumont Bar together at 45 North Main Street.

1896

The Beaumont Hotel is built.

1988

The building is listed on the National Register of Historic Places.

Today

A place to stay, meet, and make your own memories.
